points: 43% of firms with 100+ staff call quantum computing a major IT-security risk
Only 22% have analysed their cryptographic systems; 29% have implemented or planned a switch
Representative phone survey of 607 firms by Bitkom Research, fieldwork late 2025
take: Most German firms see the quantum threat but few have mapped their cryptography. A ready benchmark for board talks on post-quantum migration.
title: Bitkom: only 29% of German firms plan quantum-safe encryption
